note: Card data for Paradox Drive (B3a), which TCGdex does not have. Rules text and stats as shown by the Limitless TCG Pocket card database (pocket.limitlesstcg.com); rarity and booster packs from the open dataset pokemon-tcg-pocket-database (MIT). No flavour text, illustrator or image is taken. Kept as fetched: this is the ORIGINAL printed card data and is never edited. tools/gen_pocket_cards.mjs builds the game data from it.
